## What I did

- **Followed the drawings.** I read the engineering drawings and process router and made each component from raw material.
- **Machined to tolerance.** I turned, faced, drilled, milled and tapped parts on the lathe and mill to within thousandths of an inch.
- **Heat treated the steel.** The steel parts were heat treated and tempered to reach the specified hardness, verified on an HRC hardness tester.
- **Checked as I went.** I measured with digital micrometers throughout and applied GD&T principles to keep dimensions in spec.
